name: Rocket Stick Minis - Injected Pre Roll Pack (5 x 0.6g) - Sour Green Apple
description:
Big flavor, mini size. The Rocket Stick Minis Sour Green Apple pack gives you five 0.6-gram infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing with friends, or keeping a few on hand.

Sour Green Apple delivers a sharp candy punch: crisp, tart green apple up front with a mouth-watering sour snap that mellows into a smooth, sugary finish. It's a bold, taste-forward crowd-pleaser built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

5 × 0.6G infused minis — 3G total, quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Bold Sour Green Apple flavor — crisp, tart apple with a sweet candy finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every mini. Rocket Stick Minis Sour Green Apple is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
